name: maint-leak
description: M4 S14 scenario (epic #163 Phase 3b; timers; issue #193): the Maintenance Room leak and its clock event MNTIN. Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000, zone UTC, microseconds 0); unmodified pinned sources, START seeds RANDOM from DSKDATE, no RANDOM override and no seed search. The first sixteen commands are troll-combat's (the sword kills the troll at the third blow under this clock and seed), then `north` to the East-West Passage, `north` to the Deep Ravine, `down` to Reservoir South, `up` to the Deep Canyon, `east` to the Dam, `north` to the Dam Lobby and `north` to the Maintenance Room (the Loud Room route through the Echo Room is avoided: ECHO-ROOM reads its own input without a prompt). `push blue button` (MAINT-ROOM 77act1.mud:737: the leak, RVARS 1, <CLOCK-INT ,MNTIN -1>: MNTIN fires on every clock tick and raises the water level, printing it while the hero is in the room), `look`, `take tube`, `open tube`, `take putty`, `wait` (several clock ticks), `plug leak with putty` (LEAK-FUNCTION: RVARS -1, <CLOCK-INT ,MNTIN 0>: the clock stops), `wait`, `look`, `push blue button` (jammed), `south`, `score`. Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference (captured twice, byte-identical transcripts). Command 23 enters the Maintenance Room, whose action MAINT-ROOM declares PRSO as the type PRSOBJ, defined in no 1977 source file; under the #98 ADR amendment (#193, INV-11 fixed) a still-undefined attached TYPE name is not enforced, as in pinned Confusion. Gated by tests/historical_maint_leak_test.rkt (make test-m4-maint-leak); see docs/evidence/M4/DAM-CLOCKS.md and S14-PRSOBJ-DECL.md. Input ends after `score` (D3 end-of-input applies).
